heroHeadline: EU Delists Syria's Defence and Interior Ministries; Al-Sharaa Issues Decree Banning Israeli Goods
heroSubtitle: The EU Council on May 18 renewed Assad-era sanctions while delisting Syria's Ministries of Defence and Interior under the transitional government — opening direct EU security sector engagement — and the EU's restoration of the 1978 Cooperation Agreement on May 11 pledged €280 million. Transitional President Ahmad al-Sharaa issued a customs decree on May 22 reinforcing Syria's ban on Israeli-origin goods. A car bomb in Damascus killed at least one person the same day. Turkey captured 10 ISIS operatives inside Syria on May 23. Syria's transitional government has now reached 533 days since Assad's fall, with gradual diplomatic normalization advancing even as internal security challenges persist.
